description: Change data capture for a stream defined ON a VIEW - previously inert, in that the DDL was accepted but no change was ever captured. Changes to the view's single base table are captured and PROJECTED THROUGH the view: only the view's columns surface and under the view's aliases, rows outside the view's WHERE predicate never appear, an ordinary update produces the usual DELETE-of-old plus INSERT-of-new pair, and an update that moves a row OUT of the view surfaces only the DELETE half. DML consumption advances a view stream exactly as it does a table stream. Views the change-tracking restrictions forbid are rejected at CREATE STREAM with Snowflake's own per-shape sentences (both live-verified): an INNER join view IS trackable, a LEFT OUTER join is refused by join type, and a GROUP BY view is refused as an aggregate. Converted 1:1 from stream/StreamOnViewCdcTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE src (id INTEGER, v VARCHAR)
CREATE VIEW vw AS SELECT * FROM src
CREATE STREAM st ON VIEW vw
INSERT INTO src VALUES (1, 'a')
SELECT id, v, METADATA$ACTION FROM st
CREATE TABLE src (id INTEGER, v VARCHAR)
CREATE VIEW vw AS SELECT v AS label FROM src
CREATE STREAM st ON VIEW vw
INSERT INTO src VALUES (1, 'hello')
SELECT label, METADATA$ACTION FROM st
CREATE TABLE src (id INTEGER)
CREATE VIEW vw AS SELECT id FROM src WHERE id > 10
CREATE STREAM st ON VIEW vw
INSERT INTO src VALUES (1), (11)
SELECT id FROM st
CREATE TABLE src (id INTEGER, v VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO src VALUES (1, 'old')
CREATE VIEW vw AS SELECT v FROM src
CREATE STREAM st ON VIEW vw
UPDATE src SET v = 'new' WHERE id = 1
SELECT v, METADATA$ACTION FROM st ORDER BY METADATA$ACTION
CREATE TABLE src (id INTEGER, flag INTEGER)
INSERT INTO src VALUES (1, 1)
CREATE VIEW vw AS SELECT id FROM src WHERE flag = 1
CREATE STREAM st ON VIEW vw
UPDATE src SET flag = 0 WHERE id = 1
SELECT id, METADATA$ACTION FROM st
CREATE TABLE src (id INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE dst (id INTEGER)
CREATE VIEW vw AS SELECT id FROM src
CREATE STREAM st ON VIEW vw
INSERT INTO src VALUES (1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM st
INSERT INTO dst SELECT id FROM st
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM st
CREATE TABLE a (id INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE b (id INTEGER)
CREATE VIEW vw AS SELECT a.id FROM a JOIN b ON a.id = b.id
CREATE STREAM st ON VIEW vw
CREATE VIEW lvw AS SELECT a.id FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.id = b.id
CREATE STREAM lst ON VIEW lvw

error.messageContains: Change tracking is not supported on queries with joins of type '[LEFT_OUTER_JOIN]'.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE a (id INTEGER)
CREATE VIEW vw AS SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM a GROUP BY id
CREATE STREAM st ON VIEW vw

error.messageContains: Change tracking is not supported on queries with GROUP BY.
